location.evidence_note: Data-center parcel crosswalk remains unvalidated. BLM's related Green Chile Natural Gas Pipeline page lists La Mesa, NM 88044, Doña Ana County at approximately 32.0821, -106.769 for the pipeline project, not the data-center campus.

status_as_of_cutoff: local process / under regulatory hearing. As of 2026-08-11, NMED's public-notices surface lists Yucca Growth Infrastructure, LLC's YGI Microgrid (Project Jupiter) New Source Review application received 2026-04-27, completion letter dated 2026-05-27, revisions to Application 10883, draft NSR permit materials dated 2026-07-29, and an amended hearing notice for 2026-09-14. NMED OPF docket AQB 26-57(P) is active, and an 2026-08-05 hearing-officer order requires parties to address whether Project Jupiter still has a legally obtainable natural-gas supply after the State Land Office denial. No final air permit, county building/site permit, CO, energization, or commissioned data-center capacity was located.
evidence_grade: B - official regulator/docket evidence for pending air-permit and related pipeline actions; no final campus permit, construction, energization, owner, or IT-load confirmation

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department (reported by KNW)
actions.result_status: KNW reported that NMED considered the two Project Jupiter-related microgrid air applications incomplete at that stage. The underlying NMED determination letter was not retrieved.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Acoma LLC east/west microgrid applications 10732 and 10734
actions.access_caveat: Press report used because the underlying regulator letter was not accessible in the reviewed search.
actions.evidence_note: Do not treat later completeness/public review as a final permit.

actions.government_body: Doña Ana County Commission (reported by KVIA; resolution text not retrieved)
actions.result_status: Local reporting said commissioners adopted a communication resolution about Project Jupiter. The reviewed source does not establish a zoning, permit, construction, or project approval.
actions.access_caveat: The county resolution itself was not retrieved; no vote or substantive approval is inferred.
actions.evidence_note: Government action reported by local press; scope limited to communication.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department Air Quality Bureau
actions.action_type: new source review application received / prior applications withdrawn
actions.result_status: NMED's public-notices page lists Yucca Growth Infrastructure, LLC - YGI Microgrid (Project Jupiter) New Source Review Application received 2026-04-27. The same page lists the prior Acoma, LLC East Microgrid and West Microgrid applications as withdrawn 2026-04-27.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: NSR Application / Air Quality Construction Permit Application 10883; prior Acoma applications 10732 and 10734 withdrawn
actions.access_caveat: NMED document links are service.web.env.nm.gov shortlinks; some linked PDFs are not directly retrievable by curl, but titles and dates are exposed on the public-notices page.
actions.evidence_note: Official regulator evidence of a pending replacement/revised air-permit path, not approval.

actions.government_body: U.S. Bureau of Land Management, Las Cruces District Office
actions.result_status: BLM's ePlanning page for the Green Chile Natural Gas Pipeline lists NEPA status as completed, NEPA completion and FONSI dated 2026-04-27, decision date 2026-05-01, applicant Transwestern Pipeline Company, LLC, and a proposed action covering about 16 miles of new 24-inch buried natural-gas pipeline across BLM-administered public lands in Doña Ana County.
actions.access_caveat: Related energy/fuel infrastructure only; does not approve the data-center campus or NMED air permit.
actions.evidence_note: Record as related infrastructure. State trust land denial remains a blocking/uncertainty fact for a segment of the pipeline.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department (as described by Oracle; regulator record later confirmed on NMED public-notices page)
actions.result_status: Oracle stated that NMED deemed an updated Project Jupiter air-quality application complete for public review; NMED's public-notices page later listed a Completion Letter dated 2026-05-27 for the YGI Microgrid permit surface.
actions.access_caveat: Company statement is superseded/strengthened by NMED public-notices listing; completion is not a final permit.

actions.action_type: pipeline right-of-way and business-lease reconsideration denial
actions.result_status: The State Land Office officially denied Energy Transfer's request to reconsider the March 2026 denial of two rights-of-way and one business lease for a 0.6-mile portion of a proposed 17-mile natural-gas pipeline tied to Project Jupiter.
actions.access_caveat: The action concerns state trust land and a related pipeline, not a final determination on the data-center campus or air permit.
actions.evidence_note: Negative related infrastructure action; no inference that the full project is denied.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department Office of Public Facilitation
actions.result_status: NMED OPF docket AQB 26-57(P) scheduling order set a public hearing for 2026-10-19 at the Sunland Park Multi-Generational Center, technical testimony deadline 2026-10-01, and rebuttal deadline 2026-10-12. NMED's later public-notices page lists an amended hearing notice for 2026-09-14, so the October schedule should be treated as superseded or in conflict pending direct review of the amended notice.
actions.access_caveat: Later amended hearing notice title was visible on NMED public-notices, but the shortlinked PDF was not directly retrievable by curl.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department Air Quality Bureau
actions.result_status: NMED's public-notices page lists draft NSR Permit Part A 10883, draft NSR Permit Parts B/C 10883, draft Statement of Basis 10883, Spanish draft materials, and a modeling review report dated as of 2026-07-29.
actions.access_caveat: The NMED public page exposes titles and shortlinks; direct PDF download from cloud.env.nm.gov returned 403 in curl.
actions.evidence_note: Draft materials are not final permit issuance.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department Office of Public Facilitation / hearing officer
actions.action_type: order for briefing on motion to dismiss or continue
actions.result_status: The hearing officer ordered parties to submit responses by 2026-08-11 on New Energy Economy's motion to dismiss or continue and specifically ordered YGI and NMED to address fuel-supply questions, possible appeal of the State Land Office denial, alternative pipeline/fuel routes, whether Application 10883 remains constructible as proposed, and whether the source can be completed in a reasonable time.
actions.access_caveat: Procedural order; no ruling on the motion found by cutoff.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms active dispute over fuel infrastructure and constructibility.

actions.government_body: New Mexico Environment Department Air Quality Bureau / Doña Ana County / OSE
actions.action_type: permit, water, county, and construction search (negative/pending)
actions.result_status: Search located active NMED public-notices and OPF docket surfaces for Application 10883, plus BLM and State Land Office records for related pipeline infrastructure. No final air permit, county site/building permit, assessor/parcel, water-right, inspection/CO, construction, energization, or commissioning record was exposed by the cutoff.
actions.access_caveat: Doña Ana County exact parcel and local permit crosswalk remain unvalidated without records request/accounted permit-system access.
actions.evidence_note: Negative search does not prove nonexistence.

owner: Yucca Growth Infrastructure, LLC is the current NMED Air Quality Construction Permit Application 10883 applicant for the YGI Microgrid; ultimate data-center owner/tenant and energized IT capacity are not independently confirmed in official local-government records.

contradictions.topic: Green Chile pipeline path / fuel supply
contradictions.summary: BLM lists the Green Chile Natural Gas Pipeline NEPA process as completed with a 2026-05-01 decision for about 16 miles on BLM-administered public lands, while the New Mexico State Land Office denied reconsideration of rights-of-way/business lease for a state-trust-land segment on 2026-07-15. NMED's 2026-08-05 order therefore requires briefing on whether a legally obtainable gas source, alternate route, or alternate fuel-delivery system exists and whether Permit Application 10883 remains constructible as proposed.

The 2026-07-16 NMED scheduling order set a 2026-10-19 hearing, but NMED's public-notices page now lists an amended notice of hearing dated 2026-09-14. Treat the October date as superseded or unresolved until the amended notice PDF is directly reviewed.
